steps.text: Interact requests an authored chair with a fresh ticket. The avatar waits for a grant instead of snapping into a contested seat.
The lead keeps existing occupants and assigns each remaining chair once. Two requests for the same chair may receive different chairs in that group.
Movement remains Owner-driven in the platform frame. Presence supplies the seated pose; Jump or Interact moves the rider to the authored exit and releases the claim. Seats are never saved.
